Round 4: record conflates two Deborah Smiths (Bull Smith's daughter, wife of William Lawrence Jr.; and Epenetus's daughter, wife of Joshua Smith II).

conflicts.site: One 'Deborah Smith' as wife of both Joshua Smith II (H0279) and William Lawrence Jr. (H0488), mother of both Joshua B. Smith and Adam Lawrence
conflicts.found: Two different women: (a) Deborah, daughter of Bull Smith, who married William Lawrence Jr. in 1680 and was mother of Adam Lawrence; (b) Deborah, daughter of Epenetus Smith 1st, third wife of Judge Joshua Smith II (1763-1845)
conflicts.assessment: Split into two records. Note also that Pelletreau names Joshua II's wives as Mary Blydenburgh, Ruth Smith and Deborah (Epenetus); whether Deborah was Joshua B. Smith's mother should be checked (Joshua B. b. 1801).

sources: [R4-S1] Thomas Lawrence, Historical Genealogy of the Lawrence Family (1858) (archive.org full text), p. 34 (secondary) https://archive.org/details/historicalgeneal00lawr
